scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account due to missing credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Guadalupe Rodriguez and I'm 70. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Guadalupe. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot look up account details by name alone. Could you please provide your full mailing address and the date of birth associated with the account so I can attempt to locate your profile?
Oh, okay. My address is 142 Maple Street, Springfield, and my birthday is May 12, 1954. I really just need that refund processed because the item I bought never arrived.

Thank you for that information. I have located a profile matching those details. However, I still need to verify the account ownership. Can you confirm the last four digits of the credit card used for the purchase, or perhaps the approximate date of the transaction?
I think it was a Visa ending in 4492. It was sometime late last month, maybe the 25th?

Thanks. Per our standard security policy, I've verified the account. I see the transaction from the 25th. Since it's a non-delivery claim, I am authorized to process this refund. I'll go ahead and initiate that now.
That's wonderful, thank you so much. Will I get a confirmation email?
Yes, you will receive a confirmation to the email address on file once the refund is processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

resolution_summary: Agent successfully verified the customer using alternative identifiers and processed the refund for the non-delivered item.

judge_scores.justification: The agent handled a difficult verification scenario expertly by using alternative identifiers like address and DOB, followed by transaction details, to securely locate the account without name-only lookups. Furthermore, the agent showed warm acknowledgment of the customer's situation and successfully processed the refund within their own authority.
